name: LTX-Video Video-VAE (Lightricks; AutoencoderKLLTXVideo, 32x32x8, 128 channels); family note: LTX-2 VAE
version: Lightricks/LTX-Video vae/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors (diffusers-format VAE committed 2024-12-11, i.e. the v0.9.0 release of 2024-11-21; HF repo sha 8984fa25007f376c1a299016d0957a37a2f797bb). Later single-file checkpoints (ltx-video-2b-v0.9.1/0.9.5, ltxv-2b/13b-0.9.6-0.9.8) embed their own VAE; v0.9.5 announces an 'Improved VAE'.
family_note: LTX-2 (Lightricks/LTX-2, arXiv 2601.03233, audio-video model, license LTX-2 Community License 2026-01-05) ships a new video VAE (AutoencoderKLLTX2Video, 128 channels, spatial 32 / temporal 8) at vae/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors, HF gated=False. Its training data are 'a subset of the same dataset employed in LTX-Video', i.e. equally undisclosed -> same C4 FAIL and Appendix300 UNKNOWN; licence differs (free below USD 10M annual revenue). Not recorded as a separate entry because the eligibility outcome and data documentation are identical. LTX-2 card names a newer 'Lightricks/LTX-2.3' (not audited).

domain.value: Video-VAE (causal 3D conv encoder, denoising decoder) of the LTX-Video DiT text/image-to-video diffusion model; trained on a large-scale general video dataset (undisclosed)

quotes.quote: LTX-Video is the first DiT-based video generation model capable of generating high-quality videos in real-time. It produces 30 FPS videos at a 1216×704 resolution faster than they can be watched.
Trained on a large-scale dataset of diverse videos, the model generates high-resolution videos with realistic and varied content.
our Video-VAE applies a spatio-temporal compression of 32 × 32 × 8 32\times 32\times 8 with 128 channels, resulting in a total compression of 1:192
Causal Encoder utilizing 3D Causal Convolutions, applying 32 × 32 × 8 32\times 32\times 8 compression (except the first frame, which is encoded as a separate latent frame).

architecture.type: 3D causal convolutional VAE with patchify (4x4) at the VAE input, KL latent, timestep-conditioned denoising decoder; compression 32x32x8 with 128 latent channels (1:192)
architecture.representation: encoder latents: 128 channels per latent voxel, each voxel = 8 frames x 32 x 32 pixels (first frame encoded as its own latent frame)

pretraining_data.summary: Paper: 'publicly available data, supplemented with licensed material', filtered by an internal aesthetic model, motion filter, black-bar cropping, internal re-captioning; no datasets or providers named. LTX-2 uses a subset of the same dataset.

quotes.quote: 3 Data Preparation Our training dataset comprises a robust collection of publicly available data, supplemented with licensed material, ensuring a diverse and comprehensive training environment and enabling our model to generate a wide variety of visual content.
Videos are also processed to crop out any black bars, thus standardizing the aspect ratios and enhancing the usable visual data.
5 Training Data We used a subset of the same dataset employed in LTX-Video [ 11 ] , focusing on video clips that contained significant and informative audio components.
